text: State the components of the relational data model, its keys and its integrity constraints.
Construct an entity-relationship model for a given application domain and map it to a relational schema.
Formulate queries against a relational database using relational algebra and SQL.
Analyse the functional dependencies of a relation to identify anomalies and decompose it into a normal form.
Explain transaction processing, concurrency control protocols and recovery mechanisms.
Evaluate alternative database designs and indexing strategies for a given workload and justify the preferred option.
